method: One actual shot ID, final diagnostic and canonical score transitions. Initial official block/save can precede a same-shot goal upgrade; do not add them as mutually exclusive final outcomes. Raw legal restart restrictions and last boundary fields can be stale; normalised provenance requires uninterrupted episode lineage. Internal expectation is not validated xG.

goalLedger.boundaryNote: Goal geometry is the physical shot/score transition. The lastBoundaryCrossing field may describe an earlier non-goal exit and is not attributed to this goal.
